title: CCEA Fixes Sugarcane FRP for 2026-27 Season at Record ₹365 per Quintal
summary: Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) of sugarcane fixed at ₹365/qtl for basic 10.25% recovery rate for 2026-27 sugar season.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 CCEA Fixes Sugarcane FRP for 2026-27 Season at Record ₹365 per Quintal. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: CCEA approved sugarcane FRP of **₹365/quintal** for Sugar Season 2026-27 (Oct-Sept), 100.5% over A2+FL cost of production (₹182/qtl) on CACP recommendations.
